title: Eagles list Saquon Barkley as questionable; DeVonta Smith, Dontayvion Wicks ruled out

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Eagles list Saquon Barkley as questionable; DeVonta Smith, Dontayvion Wicks ruled out
sources.description: The Eagles have left the door open for running back Saquon Barkley to play on Monday night, but they will be down two wideouts against the Cowboys.
